title: 第112章 伐天！
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

749局指挥中心。

“咕咚。”

王斌艰难地咽了口唾沫，他感觉自己的喉咙干得快要冒烟了。

“这……这就是我们华夏的……第一位皇帝？”

没有人回答他。

因为所有人都被那股君临天下的无上威仪给镇住了。

他们隔着屏幕，都能感觉到那股几乎要溢出画面的霸气。

周玄策死死地盯着屏幕，他的大脑在飞速运转。

仙门、神话、封神之战、长青仙宗、始皇帝、仙秦运朝……

这些看似毫无关联的碎片，正在他的脑海里，拼接成一幅波澜壮阔，超乎想象的历史真相。

而这幅画卷的中心，就是那个始终一脸平淡的青衣身影。

“他……他到底还藏着多少秘密……”周玄策喃喃自语。

天空之上。

嬴政站在帝辇之上，他的目光穿透了千米的距离，落在了顾长青的身上。

那双深邃霸道的眼眸中，没有了面对天下苍生时的冷漠和威严，反而流露出了一丝……如同火焰般灼热的情感。

那是久别重逢的喜悦。

是看到战友归来的激动。

更是……找到了主心骨的安心。

两千年了。

整整两千年了。

他独自一人，在那个危机四伏，强者如林的天界，从无到有，建立起了一个庞大的仙秦帝国。

他面对过天庭的围剿，抵挡过佛门的普度，斩杀过无数上古妖魔。

他从一个初来乍到的凡人帝王，一步步成长为连玉皇大帝都感到忌惮的一方霸主。

外人只看得到他的风光，他的霸道。

却无人知晓，这两千年来，他走得有多么艰难，多么孤独。

他没有一天，不在思念着那个将他引上这条路的男人。

他没有一天，不在期盼着那个约定的实现。

而今天。

他终于等到了。

在全世界的注视下。

这位君临天下的千古一帝，缓缓地走下帝辇，踏着虚空，一步步地向着顾长青走来。

他身上的帝王威压，在靠近顾长青的过程中，一点点地收敛了起来。

最后，他停在了顾长青的面前。

脸上，露出了一个发自内心的，灿烂的笑容。

那笑容，冲散了他身上所有的霸气和威严，只剩下一种……见到故友的纯粹喜悦。

“朕的国师。”

他的声音响起，不再是之前那种威严的宣告，而是一种带着感慨和欣慰的低语。

“两千年了。”

“你，终于回来了。”

这句充满了复杂情感的话语，清晰地传入了每一个人的耳中。

所有人都被这一幕给惊呆了。

那个霸道绝伦，仿佛不将任何人放在眼里的始皇帝，在面对顾前辈的时候，竟然……如此的……亲切？

甚至，还带着一丝晚辈见到长辈时的尊敬？

“国师”这两个字，从他口中说出来，和从王贲口中说出来，分量完全不同。

那不仅仅是一个职位，更是一种……认可和依赖。

顾长青看着眼前的嬴政。

两千年的岁月，并没有在他的脸上留下太多的痕迹，只是让他原本锐利的眼神，变得更加深沉内敛。

他身上的气息，也从当年那个一心想要逆天的凡人帝王，变成了一个真正能够与神佛分庭抗礼的一方霸主。

“你做得不错。”顾长青点了点头，给予了肯定的评价。

这简单的五个字，却让嬴政脸上的笑容更加灿烂了。

对他而言，这两千年来，他听过无数的赞美和敬畏。

但没有任何一句话，比得上顾长青这句平淡的“做得不错”。

因为他知道，只有眼前这个男人，才真正明白他这两千年，到底付出了什么。

“国师，朕遵守了约定，在天界，建立了大秦。”嬴政的声音变得激昂起来，他指着身后那扇依旧敞开的天门，豪情万丈地说道。

“而你，也遵守了约定，在人间，破开了这该死的天规！”

“如今，天门已开，人间与天界的隔阂，将不复存在！”

“我仙秦的铁蹄，随时可以踏遍三界！”

他看着顾长青，眼神灼灼。

“国师，当年你我定下的伐天之约，如今，万事俱备，只欠东风！”

“而你，就是我们的东风！”

顾长青闻言，却是摇了摇头。

他看了一眼嬴政身后那支气势如虹的秦军，又看了一眼下方那些满脸狂热的修士。

然后，他平静地说道：“不，还不到时候。”

嬴政脸上的笑容微微一滞，有些不解：“为何？国师，如今杨戬逃回天庭，消息必然已经传开。天庭必定震动，阐教那些老家伙也必然会有所动作。我们正该趁他们阵脚未稳，先发制人！”

他是一个习惯了主动出击的帝王，不喜欢被动等待。

顾长青却只是淡淡地看了他一眼。

“你觉得，光靠你这点人马，就能掀翻天庭？”

“还是觉得，凭着一腔热血，就能对抗圣人道统？”

顾长青的话，如同一盆冷水，浇在了嬴政的头上。

他身后的王贲等将领，听到这话，脸上都露出了不服气的神色。

他们大秦锐士，战无不胜，攻无不克！

在天界，他们连天庭的正规军都打退过好几次，怎么到了国师口中，就成了“这点人马”？

嬴政的眉头也皱了起来。

他知道国师的眼光很高，但也没想到会高到这个地步。

他刚想开口解释一下自己仙秦的实力。

就在这时，一道金色的神光，突然从遥远的天际划过，目标直指那扇宏伟的天门！

那神光之中，包裹着一卷金色的卷轴。

卷轴上散发着玉皇大帝的无上威严和天道法则的浩瀚气息。

“是玉帝法旨！”

王贲脸色一变，立刻高声示警。

然而，那法旨的速度太快了，几乎是瞬间就来到了天门之前。

眼看着就要冲入天门，传达到仙秦的疆域。

嬴政冷哼一声。

“哼，雕虫小技，也敢在朕面前放肆！”

他正要出手，用帝王龙气将这道法旨拦下。

749 Bureau command center.

"Gudong."

Wang Bin swallowed hard. He felt that his throat was so dry that it was about to smoke.

"This...this is our...first emperor of China?"

No one answered him.

Because everyone was subdued by the supreme majesty that dominated the world.

Across the screen, they could feel the domineering force that almost overflowed the screen.

Zhou Xuance stared at the screen, his brain running rapidly.

Immortal Sect, Myth, Battle of the Gods, Evergreen Immortal Sect, First Emperor, Immortal Qin Yun Dynasty...

These seemingly unrelated fragments were being pieced together in his mind into a magnificent and unimaginable historical truth.

The center of this picture is the figure in Tsing Yi who always has a plain face.

"He...how many secrets does he still hide..." Zhou Xuance murmured to himself.

Above the sky.

Ying Zheng stood on the imperial chariot, his eyes penetrated the distance of a thousand meters and fell on Gu Changqing.

In those deep and domineering eyes, there was no longer the indifference and majesty when facing the common people in the world, but instead revealed a trace of... emotion as hot as fire.

It was the joy of meeting again after a long absence.

It’s the excitement of seeing a comrade returning.

What's more... I have found the peace of mind that is my backbone.

Two thousand years.

It's been two thousand years.

He was alone, in a world full of dangers and powerful people, and built a huge Xian Qin empire from scratch.

He has faced the siege of heaven, resisted the Buddhist sect, and killed countless ancient demons.

He has grown step by step from a new mortal emperor to an overlord that even the Jade Emperor is afraid of.

Outsiders can only see his beauty and domineering power.

But no one knows how difficult and lonely his journey has been over the past two thousand years.

There wasn't a day that went by that he didn't think about the man who had led him down this path.

Not a day goes by that he doesn't look forward to the fulfillment of that agreement.

And today.

He finally waited.

With the world watching.

The emperor who had ruled the world for eternity slowly stepped off the imperial chariot and walked towards Gu Changqing step by step through the void.

The imperial pressure on him gradually receded as he approached Gu Changqing.

Finally, he stopped in front of Gu Changqing.

A heartfelt, brilliant smile appeared on his face.

That smile dissipated all the domineering and majestic look on his body, leaving only a... pure joy of seeing an old friend.

"My national advisor."

His voice sounded, no longer the majestic declaration before, but a whisper filled with emotion and relief.

"Two thousand years."

"You are finally back."

This sentence full of complex emotions clearly reached everyone's ears.

Everyone was stunned by this scene.

The first emperor, who was extremely domineering and didn't seem to take anyone seriously, was actually...so...kind when facing Senior Gu?

Even, there is a hint of respect that juniors have when they meet their elders?

The words "National Master" had completely different weight when spoken from his mouth than from Wang Ben's mouth.

That's not just a position, it's a kind of...recognition and dependence.

Gu Changqing looked at Ying Zheng in front of him.

Two thousand years have not left many traces on his face, but have only made his originally sharp eyes become deeper and more reserved.

The aura on his body has also changed from the mortal emperor who wanted to defy heaven to an overlord who can truly compete with gods and Buddhas.

"You did a good job." Gu Changqing nodded and gave a positive evaluation.

These five simple words made the smile on Ying Zheng's face become even brighter.

For him, he had heard countless praises and awe over the past two thousand years.

But no words can compare to Gu Changqing's plain "well done".

Because he knew that only the man in front of him truly understood what he had paid for these two thousand years.

"National Master, I have abided by the agreement and established the Great Qin in the heaven." Ying Zheng's voice became passionate. He pointed at the still open door of heaven behind him and said with great pride.

"And you also kept your promise and broke this damn heavenly rule in the human world!"

"Now, the gate of heaven has been opened, and the barrier between the human world and the heaven will no longer exist!"

"My immortal Qin's iron hooves can traverse the three realms at any time!"

He looked at Gu Changqing with burning eyes.

"National Master, you and I made the agreement to defeat the sky back then. Now, everything is ready. All we need is the east wind!"

"And you are our Dongfeng!"

When Gu Changqing heard this, he shook his head.

He glanced at the powerful Qin army behind Ying Zheng, and then at the fanatical monks below.

Then, he said calmly: "No, it's not that time yet."

The smile on Ying Zheng's face froze slightly, and he was a little confused: "Why? Imperial Master, now that Yang Jian has escaped back to Heaven, the news must have spread. Heaven must be shaken, and those old guys of Chanjiao will definitely take action. We should take advantage of their unstable position and strike first!"

He is an emperor who is used to taking the initiative and does not like to wait passively.

Gu Changqing just glanced at him lightly.

"Do you think that with just a few people like you, you can overthrow the heavens?"

"Or do you think you can fight against the orthodoxy of the saints with your passion?"

Gu Changqing's words were like a basin of cold water poured on Ying Zheng's head.

Wang Ben and other generals behind him had unconvinced looks on their faces when they heard this.

They, the warriors of the Great Qin Dynasty, are invincible in every battle and conquer every attack!

In the heavenly realm, they even repulsed the regular army of the heavenly court several times. How come they became "just a few people" in the words of the national preceptor?

Ying Zheng also frowned.

He knew that the national master's vision was very high, but he did not expect it to be so high.

He was just about to open his mouth to explain his Xian Qin's strength.

At this moment, a golden divine light suddenly flashed across the distant sky, aiming directly at the magnificent heavenly gate!

There was a golden scroll wrapped in the divine light.

The scroll exudes the supreme majesty of the Jade Emperor and the vast aura of the laws of heaven.

"It's the Jade Emperor's decree!"

Wang Ben's expression changed and he immediately shouted a warning.

However, the speed of the decree was too fast, and it arrived in front of Tianmen almost instantly.

He was about to rush into Tianmen and reach the territory of Xian Qin.

Ying Zheng snorted coldly.

"Hmph, you're just a little skilled, but you dare to be so presumptuous in front of me!"

He was about to take action and used the imperial dragon energy to stop the decree.
